subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt all five memory roles, per-agent overrides, and hook-level role gating as the permanent public plugin and configuration contract?
rationale: Code review cannot determine the intended long-term taxonomy, especially when some proposed roles currently provide owner selection without a complete role-specific invocation or lifecycle protocol.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Approve only roles with complete current runtime semantics and defer dreaming or user-model ownership until their invocation and lifecycle contracts are defined.

options.title: Sponsor all five roles
options.body: Approve the full taxonomy and per-agent model, then require exact-head migration and runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Pause this architecture
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and supersede this branch if maintainers prefer a different memory-composition model.

recommendation.title: Narrow the initial contract
recommendation.body: Approve only roles with complete current runtime semantics and defer dreaming or user-model ownership until their invocation and lifecycle contracts are defined.

likelyOwner.reason: The broad product and public-API decision was explicitly routed to this person, making them the strongest available owner for the permanent contract choice.
